name: Speech Detection
description: Finds exactly where people are talking, so silence removal skips breaths, music and room noise instead of cutting them as speech.
details: Silero VAD v5 in ONNX: one speech probability every 32 ms of 16 kHz audio. Used by Detect / Remove Silence with the voice-activity method and to tighten transcript word timings. Package id: silero.vad.
author: CutWire
